title: Positive sectional curvature on exotic spheres in dimensions 8 and 10: a Lean formalisation
description: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalisation of the new arguments of F. Galaz-García, Positive sectional curvature on the exotic 8-sphere and order-three homotopy 10-spheres (2026). Every step is checked by Lean's kernel, except five cited published results (Reiser–Wraith, Sperança, Kervaire–Milnor, Hitchin, orientation reversal in Θ₁₀), which enter as explicit hypotheses. The Lean code was written by Claude (Anthropic) under the direction and supervision of the author.
